Each summary includes the current year results, as well as results for the previous year, a three-year rolling average, and provincial summary results for comparison. The Alberta Education Assurance Measures provide school boards with a consistent way to measure their success and assess progress using a broad spectrum of measures. Reporting results allows Albertans to see how their school authority is performing and ensures that the entire education system is open and accountable. Participation in the Alberta Education Assurance survey, provincial achievement tests (PATs) and diploma examinations were impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic in 2021.
results.title: Alberta Education Assurance Measures results : 2021 school authority summaries
